gate.steady_gate_note: no repeatability-derived tolerance exists; reported, not enforced

summary.scope: Conditional necessity is bounded to THIS fixed trace, fixed routing and timing, an additive deposition intervention, and the HotSpot model. It is not general physical causality and says nothing about temperature-dependent power feedback.

raw_output_bundle.note: Retained so the temperatures can be independently reparsed. Lives on the run host's data volume, which is shared and periodically cleaned -- the hash identifies the bytes, it does not guarantee they still exist.
